```{r setup}
source("../R/portal_config.R")
cfg <- portal_cfg
labs <- portal_labels
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This preview uses a snapshot of the release `r cfg$previous_release` files (coverage: `r labs$month_range(cfg$coverage$start, cfg$coverage$snapshot_end)`, a box around Europe). For up-to-date numbers, use the data: see [Data](data/index.qmd).
:::

The flight list, flight events and measurements give insight into topics such as traffic counts and runway, taxiway and parking position use at airports.

::: {.callout-caution}
## Disclaimer

The preview plots may lag the latest published data and only illustrate. Use the downloadable datasets for authoritative figures. Numbers depend on ADS-B coverage; the history of the OpenSky Network's ADS-B coverage is on its [facts page](https://opensky-network.org/network/facts).
:::

### Traffic at top 20 European airports
The 20 European airports with the most observed flights during 2022 and 2024. Source: the **OPDI flight list** on [Release v0.0.2](data/v0.0.2.qmd).

<div class="plotly-container1">
```{r top20_airports_plot}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)

# Read data
combined_flight_counts <- read_parquet('../data/02_analytic_data/total_flights_per_airport_pm.parquet')
combined_flight_counts <- combined_flight_counts %>% filter(!is.na(APT))

# Calculate total flights per airport and select top 20
top_20_airports <- combined_flight_counts %>%
  group_by(APT) %>%
  summarize(total_flights = sum(detected_flights, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_flights)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(APT)

# Filter data for top 20 airports
top_20_data <- combined_flight_counts %>%
  filter(APT %in% top_20_airports)

# Assign different colors for each airport
airport_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set2"))(length(top_20_airports))

# Create Plotly stacked bar chart for top 20 airports
p <- plot_ly(data = top_20_data) %>%
  add_trace(
    x = ~month, 
    y = ~detected_flights, 
    type = 'bar', 
    color = ~APT, 
    colors = airport_colors, 
    text = ~APT,
    hoverinfo = 'text'
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = 'Monthly observed flights for top 20 Airports',
    yaxis = list(title = 'Monthly detected flights'),
    xaxis = list(title = 'Month'),
    barmode = 'stack'
  )

# Show plot
p
```
</div>

### Traffic at all medium and large European airports (1121 airports)

Detected traffic for all European medium and large airports. The dropdown menu lists the 1121 airports alphabetically. Source: the **OPDI flight list** on [Release v0.0.2](data/v0.0.2.qmd).

<div class="plotly-container2">
```{r all_airports_dropdown_plot}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)

combined_flight_counts <- read_parquet('../data/02_analytic_data/total_flights_per_airport_pm.parquet')

combined_flight_counts <- combined_flight_counts %>% filter(!is.na(APT))

# Create Plotly stacked bar chart with dropdown for airports
p <- plot_ly(data = combined_flight_counts) %>%
  add_bars(x = ~month, y = ~detected_flights, name = 'Flights', marker = list(color = 'blue')) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = 'Monthly observed flights for all airports'),  # Initial title
    yaxis = list(title = 'Monthly observed flights'),
    xaxis = list(title = 'Month'),
    barmode = 'stack',
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = 'dropdown',
        active = 0,
        buttons = lapply(
          sort(unique(combined_flight_counts$APT)), function(airport) {
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(
                  x = list(
                    combined_flight_counts$month[combined_flight_counts$APT == airport]
                  ),
                  y = list(
                    combined_flight_counts$detected_flights[combined_flight_counts$APT == airport]
                  )
                ),
                list(
                  title = paste("Monthly observed flights for", airport)  # Update title with selected airport
                )
              ),
              label = airport
            )
          }
        ),
        direction = "down",
        showactive = TRUE
      )
    )
  )

# Show plot
p
```
</div>

### Flight events in function of the measurement distance flown (NM)
Analyse a flight with the predefined **OPDI flight events** and **OPDI measurements**, as in the example below. Source: the **OPDI flight events** and **OPDI measurements** on [Release v0.0.2](data/v0.0.2.qmd).

```{r events_vs_distance}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)  # for reading parquet files
library(plotly)

tmp <- read_parquet('../data/02_analytic_data/example_events.parquet')
tmp <- tmp %>% filter(type.y == 'Distance flown (NM)')

# Create scatter plot
fig <- plot_ly(tmp, x = ~value, y = ~altitude, color = ~type.x, type = 'scatter', mode = 'markers') %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Measurement: Distance flown (NM)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Altitude (ft)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Flight event")),
    title = "Flight events in function of the measurement distance flown (NM)"
  )

# Display plot
fig
```
<br>
```{r events_vs_time}
# Load required libraries

    yaxis = list(title = "Altitude (ft)"),
```
